verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a commerce platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk-edit, batch endpoint, or multi-item operation. It covers single-resource REST CRUD, a general-purpose CLI, MCP access, and dashboard product updates. These are building blocks a developer could script into bulk workflows, not a documented bulk capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
